# core.forcing.ResolvedSegment { #climatecritters.core.forcing.ResolvedSegment }

```python
core.forcing.ResolvedSegment(kind, t0, tf, y0, yf, eval_mode, params)
```

Immutable record describing one compiled segment of a `ForcingSequence`.

Users do not construct this directly.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**kind**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Element kind (``'hold'``, ``'ramp'``, ``'harmonic'``, ``'func'``).

<code>[**t0, tf**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Absolute start and end times in model time units.

<code>[**y0, yf**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Forcing value at ``t0`` and ``tf``.

<code>[**eval_mode**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Evaluation rule (``'constant'``, ``'linear'``, ``'cosine'``, ``'harmonic'``, ``'func'``).

<code>[**params**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[dict](`dict`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Mode-specific evaluation parameters (e.g. amplitude, omega, callable).
